title: ABC Trading Recalls Squishy Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Water Bead Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
hazard: The squishy toys violate the mandatory safety standard for toys because the water beads inside the toys expand larger than permitted, posing a deadly ingestion hazard. If a water bead is ingested, it can pose ingestion, choking, and intestinal obstruction hazards inside a child's body, resulting in severe discomfort, vomiting, dehydration and a risk of death to a child.
description: This recall involves squishy dumpling and crazy squib ball toys. The squishy dumplings, model 3655, come in multiple translucent colors, containing glitter and water beads. The toys have a cartoon face and are packaged in a tan plastic container shaped like a bamboo steamer. "SQUISHY DUMPLING" is printed on the front of the removable package labeling. There are no markings on the product, other than the cartoon face. The crazy squib balls, model 3984, come in multiple translucent colors, containing glitter and water beads. The toys come individually wrapped in a white netting. "CRAZY SQUIB BALL" and "Squeeze it! Throw it!" are printed on the front of the package labeling.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the squishy toys immediately and contact ABC Trading for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write "RECALLED" in permanent marker on the squishy toys, throw the toy away and email a photo of the disposed toy to recallabc@gmail.com.

title: Agrish Reannounces and Expands Recall of Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; Additional Units Added
hazard: The recalled bed rails violate the mandatory standard for adult portable bed rails because when the bed rails are attached to a bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress, posing a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. The bed rails do not meet structural stability or retention strap requirements, posing a fall hazard. Additionally, the bed rails’ push pins and push pin holes are incorrectly sized, posing a laceration hazard.
description: This recall involves Agrish-branded adult portable bed rails, models AG-12011, 12014 and 12016, for use on adult beds. The model numbers are printed in the owner’s manual and labeled on the bed rail’s metal post. The recalled bed rails have white tubing with rounded gray foam rubber handle grips. Each model has multiple batch numbers and manufacture dates listed on the unit and the instruction manual.
remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled adult portable bed rails and contact Agrish Direct for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to go to http://www.agrish.online/recall to register for the recall and receive instructions on how to dispose of the recalled bed rail.
manufacturer: Zhongshan Lebo Medical Co., Ltd., of China

description: This recall involves the Cupcakes and Cashmere Brand Three-Light Floor Lamps, model 7927-OZ and model 7927-OZ1. The lamps measure about 63-inches tall and have three six-inch diameter glass globe lampshades. The lamps are sold in multicolor and cream variants. title: GBYMIUY Recalls Magnetic Stick Figure Toy Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
hazard: The magnetic stick figure toy sets violate the mandatory standard for toys because they can liberate loose high-powered magnets posing an ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other or other metal objects and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death.
description: This recall involves GBYMIUY stick figure toy sets. The magnetic toys were sold in packs of 30 multi-colored transparent and opaque human-shaped figures. Each figure measures about 2.91 inches tall by 2.3 inches wide. The toys contain magnets in the hand and foot locations. "GBYMIUY" and number "X004TVHD2Z" are printed on the product packaging.
remedy: Consumers should take the stick figures away from children immediately, stop using them and contact GBYMIUY for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to throw away the stick figure toys and send a photo of the disposed toys to zhangfa0426@outlook.com.

title: Gobi Heat Recalls Rechargeable Hand Warmers Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
hazard: The lithium-ion battery and electrical components in the recalled hand warmers can overheat and ignite, posing a risk of serious injury from fire and burn hazards.
description: This recall involves Gobi Heat-branded rechargeable hand warmers. The black with gray hand warmers were sold in packs of two warmers that can be magnetically joined together and include a charging cable. The hand warmers have a USB-C port to charge the built-in lithium-ion batteries in each unit. The adjustable-heat hand warmers have LED indicator lights on the hard plastic shell and come with a silicone lanyard.  “Gobi Heat” is printed on the top of the hand warmers and on the product packaging, and model number “UT3053” on the underside.
remedy:
Consumers should stop using the recalled hand warmers immediately and contact Gobi Heat for a full refund or store credit, equal to full refund of the purchase price plus 20% of that amount. Consumers will be asked to go to https://gobiheat.com/pages/handwarmer-recall to obtain a claim number and instructions to destroy the hand warmers by writing in permanent marker “Recalled” on the product and send a photo, showing the marked hand warmer and the product’s model, to recall@gobiheat.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product with the lithium-ion battery, in accordance with applicable local and state hazardous waste regulations. 

Note: Do not throw this recalled lithium-ion battery or device in the trash, the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Recalled lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries, because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this recalled lithium-ion battery or device for disposal. Before taking your battery or device to a HHW collection center, contact that office ahead of time and ask whether it accepts recalled lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance.

Once the return is processed, the customers will receive the refund in the same form of payment as they used for their original purchase.

description: This recall involves CIYTI Light-Up Princess Costumes. The costumes include a blue dress with a crown and wand that light up, and a remote control. The crowns, scepters, and remote controls contain button batteries. There are no markings on the product. The package has "CIYTI" on the front.
remedy: Consumers should take the princess costumes away from children immediately, stop using them and contact FoShanShiNanHaiQuNuoAiTongZhuangShangHang for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write "RECALLED" with permanent marker on the dress, crown, wand, and remote, then throw away the toys and submit a photo of the disposed toys to Norakid2026@outlook.com. Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.

title: Lithonia Lighting Recalls RSX Luminaires with Adjustable Tilt Arm Mountings Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Impact Hazard
hazard: The knuckle of the recalled adjustable tilt arm mountings can fail, allowing the luminaire to fall from the mounting arm, posing a risk of serious injury due to impact hazard.
description: This recall involves Luminaires with certain adjustable tilt mounting arms manufactured between August 2019 to July 2020 and August 2024 to April 2026: AASP, AARP, AAWB, and AAWSC. The adjustable tilt arm mounts the RSX luminaire to a square pole, round pole, wall bracket or wall bracket with surface mount conduit. The arm mount allows the luminaire to be tilted from 0 degrees to 90 degrees above horizontal. Consumers should contact Lithonia Lighting to confirm their Luminaire with adjustable tilt mounting arms are included in the recall.
remedy: Consumers should keep clear of the area directly beneath the Luminaire and contact Lithonia Lighting to schedule a free repair. Lithonia Lighting will arrange for a qualified professional to replace the recalled adjustable tilt arm mount with a new complete adjustable arm assembly.

title: VQQQ Gas Patio Heaters Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards
hazard: Components on the recalled patio heaters can malfunction, causing gas to be released, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire and burn hazards.
description: This recall involves VQQQ-branded natural gas patio heaters, models VQQQ-A1 and VQQQ-001. They have a bronze pole with a round base and a silver mushroom-shaped top with an adjustable height of 55 inches to 78 inches. A 24-foot-long gray gas hose is attached to the heater's base. The brand and model numbers are printed on the product's purchase receipt.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled patio heaters immediately, shut the valve at the portable gas source, disconnect the gas hose and contact VQQQ for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker "Recalled" on the heater's base and send a photo of the marked heater to vqqqrecall@163.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: Do Not Drive: Loss of Vehicle Control
hazard: A ball joint that separates from the lower control arm can cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
description: SUSPENSION Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2026 Crosstrek and Forester vehicles. The castle nut on the left-front lower control arm ball joint may be improperly fastened, which can lead to the ball joint separating from the lower control arm.
remedy: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicle until the remedy is completed. Dealers will inspect and replace the left-front lower control arm ball joint assembly, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 16, 2026.  Owners may contact Subaru customer service at 1-844-373-6614.  Subaru's number for this recall is WRI26.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Backer Material May Be Insufficient to Secure Refrigerator In Place
hazard: An unsecured refrigerator may move or tip over during transit, increases the risk of injury.
description: EQUIPMENT Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Campsite Reserve travel trailers. The backer material to secure the refrigerator in place may fail.
remedy: Dealers will install more backer material, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 28, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-260-499-2100. Forest River's number for this recall is 62-2106.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Do Not Drive: Center Lock May Break Causing Wheel Detachment
hazard: Wheel detachment can result in a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
description: WHEELS Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2024 718 Cayman GT4 RS, 911 Turbo S, 911 Turbo, 911 S/T, 911 GT3 RS, 911 GT3, 911 Carrera GTS, and 718 Spyder RS vehicles. The center lock wheel bolt may fracture and cause the wheel to detach.
remedy: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until they have been repaired. Dealers will check the center lock wheel fastening system and replace any incorrectly manufactured parts, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 15, 2026. Owners may contact Porsche customer service at 1-800-767-7243. Porsche's number for this recall is ATA1. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 24V809. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 20, 2026.

title: Toys: COOL.TRICYCLES/  Tricycle électrique pour garçons, jouets interactifs éducatifs et créatifs
hazard: Chemical. The screw that secures the battery compartment is not captive. If the screw is lost when the batteries are being changed, the cover of the battery compartment could be removed easily. If a child puts them in the mouth, the batteries can overheat and release electrolyte which can be ingested by the child and cause damage to the gastrointestinal tract.
description: Character toy electric tricycle, battery operated, with LEDs on wheels and on the propeller. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with European standards EN 62115 and EN 71-1.
remedy: Warning Consumers Of Risks; Removal From Online Marketplace

title: Childcare Articles: Baby Teething Glove
hazard: Asphyxiation, Choking. The product has a protruding part that is too long (lion-shaped protrusion). Small children may put it in the mouth and choke.
description: Purple silicone baby teether bracelet with cover. The product label states “baby teething glove.” The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive.
remedy: Import Rejected At Border; Removal From Online Marketplace
country: United Kingdom in respect of Northern Ireland

title: Childcare Articles: Auto-Close Baby Safety Gate YARDIN Treppenschutzgitter
hazard: Entrapment, Injuries, Strangulation. The gaps in the gate are large enough that a small child could slip through them and get stuck, which poses a risk of suffocation.
description: White stair gate, size 85-95, price €35.99. The product does not comply with the General Product Safety Regulation nor with the European standard EN 1930.
remedy: Product Withdrawal From Market; Product Recall From Consumers

title: Pyrotechnic Articles: Destroyer
hazard: Asphyxiation, Burns, Damage_To_Sight, Injuries. The fireworks may burst or release burning material over an extended period of time after functioning. The user might reignite the product, which may result in the user being hit by the pyrotechnical effects and matter from the product. This can lead to injuries, burns and damage to sight. The user may bring the product inside and it may release burning material in the building. Consequently, this poses a risk of asphyxiation.
description: Battery with 100 shots. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Pyrotechnic Directive nor the European standard EN 15947-5.
remedy: Product Withdrawal From Market

title: Electrical Appliances: Dual USB Charger Kit
hazard: Electric_Shock. The product lacks adequate insulation between the primary and secondary circuits. The USB ports and the connected cable can become live under mains voltage. Consequently, the user may receive an electric shock.
description: White mains USB charger with two USB-A ports, integrated EU plug, and a charging cable. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 60335-1.
remedy: Product Withdrawal From Market; Product Recall From Consumers

title: Protective Equipment: Road Cycling Helmet for Outdoor Sports
hazard: Injuries. In the event of an impact, the helmet's retention system could easily become detached and the helmet could completely slip off the head of the user, leaving it exposed to injuries.
description: Bicycle helmet. The product does not comply with the Personal Protective Equipment Regulation nor with the European standard EN 1078.
remedy: Product Recall From Consumers

title: Electrical Appliances: Dual USB-C Charger
hazard: Electric_Shock. The product lacks adequate insulation between the primary and secondary circuits. The USB ports and the connected cable can become live under mains voltage. Consequently, the user may receive an electric shock.
description:
White plastic USB charger with two USB-C outports. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage
Directive nor with the European standard EN 60335-1.
remedy: Product Recall From Consumers; Product Withdrawal From Market; Ban Marketing Of Product; Destruction Of Product

title: Electrical Appliances: 3 USB Charger
hazard: Electric_Shock. The creepage and clearance distances between the primary and secondary side in the “safety extra low voltage” (SELV) transformer of the product are inadequate. Live parts of the product may become accessible to the user which may result in an electric shock.
description: USB phone charger with 3 USB Type-A outports. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 62368-1.
remedy: Removal From Online Marketplace

title: Hobby Sports Equipment: E-Bike
hazard: Fire. The charger plug of the product has an insufficient fuse. If there is a fault with the product, it could overheat and catch fire. There is no valid technical documentation for the product and no evidence of production control. In the absence of evidence to demonstrate the conformity of the product, it may be possible for it to overheat and catch fire.
description: Black electric bicycle with a battery and charger. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Machinery Directive.
remedy: Destruction Of Product; Import Rejected At Border; Removal From Online Marketplace
country: United Kingdom in respect of Northern Ireland

title: Hyundai Motor America: Wheel May Detach
hazard: Wheel detachment can cause a loss of vehicle control or create a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
description: WHEELS Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2026 Venue, Elantra N, Elantra Hybrid, and Elantra vehicles. The wheel lug nuts may loosen and allow the wheel to detach.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and tighten the wheel assembly lug nuts, and replace the hub bearing assembly, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 19, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 310. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 23, 2026.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Loss of Steering Control From Loose Fasteners
hazard: A loss of vehicle steering control increases the risk of a crash.
description: SUSPENSION Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2026 Tucson Hybrid and Elantra vehicles. The front strut assembly fasteners may not be tightened properly, which can result in a loss of vehicle steering control.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the front strut assembly fasteners and perform a wheel alignment, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 19, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 309. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 23, 2026.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Solar Panel Wiring May Be Loose
hazard: A loose wire may increase the risk of a fire.
description: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023-2026 Pause travel trailers. The incorrect connector was used to secure the 12 volt solar panel wires.
remedy: Dealers will install a new connector, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 28, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-535-2748. Forest River's number for this recall is 426-2107.

title: Motor Vehicles: Caddy, Golf Sportsvan, Golf Variant 7, Tiguan, Tiguan Allspace, Touran
hazard: Injuries. Moisture ingress could lead to corrosion of a steering rack bolt, which may result in a fracture of the bolt and a loss of steering capability, increasing the risk of accidents.
description: Passenger car. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
remedy: Product Recall From Consumers

title: Autocar, LLC: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel
hazard: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
description: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2022-2027 ACX (Xpeditor) vehicles equipped with Cummins L9 diesel engines, part number D563027BX03. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
remedy: Cummins will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 17, 2026. Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467 or Autocar customer service at 1-888-218-3611. Cummins number for this recall is C7311. Autocar's number for this recall is ACX-2603.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire
hazard: A vehicle fire increases the risk of injury.
description: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Q4 E-Tron and Q4 Sportback E-Tron vehicles. The high voltage battery may fail and cause a fire.
remedy: Owners are advised to only charge their vehicles to a maximum of 80% capacity until the repair has been completed. The remedy is currently under development. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed December 18, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834. Audi's number for this recall is 93SK. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 23, 2026.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Heater Hose May Rupture and Leak
hazard: Contact with hot coolant may burn occupants, increasing the risk of injury.
description: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain Thomas Built Buses 2027 Saf-T-Liner C2 school buses. The heater hose may rupture, which can result in hot coolant leaking inside the passenger compartment.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the heater hose as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 18, 2026. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712. DTNA's number for this recall is F1043.

title: Koenigsegg Automotive AB: Unintended Vehicle Movement from Disengaged Electronic Parking Brake
hazard: Unintended vehicle movement increases the risk of a crash or injury.
description: PARKING BRAKE Koenigsegg Automotive AB (Koenigsegg) is recalling certain 2025-2026 CC850 vehicles. The electronic parking brake may not engage properly when the vehicle is in reverse, allowing in unintended vehicle movement.
remedy: The parking brake control software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected be mailed October 29, 2026. Owners may contact Koenigsegg's customer service at 703-712-8324.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Instrument Panel Display Failure/FMVSS 101
hazard: An instrument panel display that fails to show engine oil pressure, engine coolant temperature, or electrical charge increases the risk of a crash.
description: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Lexus  NX250, NX350, NX350 Hybrid, and NX450h+ vehicles. The instrument panel cluster combination meter may fail to display certain warnings or indicators. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Control and Displays."
remedy: Dealers will update the combination meter software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's number for this recall is 26LA10.

title: Ford Motor Company: Replacement ABS Module May Be Incorrectly Programmed
hazard: An incorrectly programmed ABS may cause a loss of ABS and degrade brake balance, increasing the distance needed to stop and the risk of a crash.
description: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) modules with part number EB5Z-2C219-B, DB5Z-2C219-B, CB5Z-2C219-C, DL1Z-2C219-A, or DT4Z-2C219-B. The replacement ABS module may be programmed with the incorrect software, preventing the ABS from functioning as intended.
remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the ABS module as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S76.
